Evidence that the upper-extremity muscles have a greater predisposition to EIMD than the leg muscles suggests a protective benefit in muscles that are frequently used during everyday activities (37). Other factors that can influence the magnitude of the protective effect include the specific composition of exercise variables (e.g., training intensity, velocity, number of damaging contractions), muscle length, muscle group, age, and sex (122).
